title: cephaelis involucrans
intro: Cephaelis involucrans, commonly known as Wild Ipecac or Cephaelis, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is native to Central and South America and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Cephaelis involucrans include its emetic and purgative effects, which can aid in treating respiratory issues and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of Cephaelis involucrans include alkaloids such as emetine and cephaeline, which exhibit therapeutic actions including expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimalarial properties.
